title: Smoke and Bandoneon
style: Electro-tango lounge, 104 BPM, sultry bandoneon melodies, nightclub piano, downtempo electronic beat with tango rhythm accents, deep warm bass, plucked strings, smoky vintage jazz-diva female vocal, sensual late-night cabaret atmosphere
negativeTags: rock, metal, country, EDM drop, chiptune, rap, happy pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Red velvet curtain, a cigarette glow
The band in the corner is playing it slow
You walked in at midnight with rain on your coat
I sang you a promise in one silver note

[Chorus]
Smoke and bandoneon, pull me in close
The night is a dancer that nobody knows
Smoke and bandoneon, sway till the dawn
Hold me like music, then you'll be gone

[Verse 2]
The piano is sighing the things we won't say
Your eyes keep on asking me, darling, to stay
One more for the lovers, one more for the lost
I'll pay for the heartbreak, whatever the cost

[Bridge]
Paso a paso, step by step
Every turn a sweet regret

[Chorus]
Smoke and bandoneon, pull me in close
The night is a dancer that nobody knows
